collections.users: Employee accounts with single role (OWNER, ADMINISTRATOR, CASHIER, INVENTORY_PERSONNEL, DELIVERY_PERSONNEL)
collections.customers: Registered customer business profiles with normalized contact numbers and active/archived state
collections.customer_addresses: Multiple delivery addresses per customer with one default address
collections.products: Product catalog (V1 primary: Jug of purified water, PHP 25 configurable)
collections.inventory_items: Tracked inventory items (JUG, CAP, PLASTIC_FILM_SEAL) with minimum stock levels
collections.inventory_movements: Immutable inventory movement ledger (RESTOCK, ADJUSTMENT_IN, ADJUSTMENT_OUT, SALE_CONSUMPTION, RETURN, RESERVATION, RESERVATION_RELEASE)
collections.gallon_movements: Immutable quantity-based company jug accountability ledger (RELEASED_TO_CUSTOMER, RETURNED_BY_CUSTOMER, ADJUSTMENT)
collections.orders: Delivery orders created by Customer or Staff (WALK_IN does not require prior Order record)
collections.deliveries: One-to-one delivery fulfillment records tied to Orders (PENDING, ASSIGNED, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED, FAILED)
collections.payments: Payment transactions (CASH, PAYMONGO) managed and verified by trusted Cloud Functions
collections.sales: Immutable finalized sales records with server-generated unique receipt numbers
collections.sale_corrections: Owner/Admin correction records referencing original sales without mutating original history
collections.audit_logs: Immutable audit trail entries for security-sensitive and business-critical operations
collections.daily_metrics: Pre-aggregated daily summary documents powering performant dashboards
